summary: newcleo plc furnished a 6-K reporting that its October 6, 2026 general meeting passed, by poll of 128,658,930 votes for (99.98%), 24,336 against and 158,058 withheld, the ordinary resolution approving a Prepaid Share Forward Confirmation dated September 11, 2026 among the Company, NewHold Investment Corp III and Tech Opportunities LLC for the off-market purchase by newcleo of up to 7,000,000 of its ordinary shares. Authority expires five years after passage unless renewed, varied or revoked. No price, premium, advisor or recommendation is disclosed; mechanics resemble a US buyback/forward repurchase authorization. Watch actual execution pace and share-count impact.
